request.style: English, male baritone solo with choir, piano, strings, organ, gentle mood, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A maskil sung by Ethan the Ezrahite
I will sing of the Lord's steadfast love
With my mouth I make faithfulness known
To every generation that shall come

[Chorus]
Steadfast love is built to last forever
In the heavens you establish truth
I have said so with my whole heart
God's faithfulness remains with you

[Verse]
I have made a covenant with my chosen
I have sworn to David my servant
I will establish your offspring forever
And build your throne for all generations

[Chorus]
Steadfast love is built to last forever
In the heavens you establish truth
I have said so with my whole heart
God's faithfulness remains with you

[Verse]
The promise stands firm through every age
No shadow falls upon this vow
Your mercy endures beyond time
A foundation strong and sure now

[Chorus]
Steadfast love is built to last forever
In the heavens you establish truth
I have said so with my whole heart
God's faithfulness remains with you

[Bridge]
Sing of the grace that never fades
Declare the truth to all who hear
The covenant holds through every storm
Faithfulness beyond all fear

[Outro]
I will sing of the Lord's love
Forever and evermore
Steadfast love is built to last
In the heavens and on the shore
